subject: Startups
title: Secondary Sales
description: A micro-lesson that makes Secondary Sales usable.

hook.text: A founder hasn't taken a salary in two years. An investor offers to buy $500K of their shares. Is that okay?

buildup.text: Secondary sales let founders and early employees sell some shares before an IPO. They provide liquidity without an exit.

discovery.text: Platforms like Forge and EquityZen built markets for secondary shares. Pre-IPO trading became a real thing.

twist.text: Too much secondary selling worries investors—it signals that insiders are cashing out.

climax.text: Secondary sales keep founders motivated. A founder with zero cash and millions in paper wealth is fragile.

punchline.text: Some liquidity keeps founders sane—and in the game longer.

quiz.question: What are secondary sales?
options: Founders or employees selling shares before an IPO
